description.en: Starts a talk interaction with an NPC handle, turning them to face the player, and returns whether the NPC had to physically turn to do so.
Handle of the NPC being talked to.
True if the NPC turned to face the player to start the conversation.

example.code:
// Start talking to an NPC and check if they turned to face the player
local body_turn = CMND_TALK_START(npcHdl);
